correctness.rationale: The claimed all-k formula follows from the cited Luna-stratum product decomposition (Jordan-loop punctual framed quotients J_m for ordinary roots and framed two-cycle quotients C_m for exceptional roots). Fixed monomial Jordan quotients correspond to a+b=m (m+1), and two-cycle path truncations with parity-matched lengths give (m+1)+m=2m+1; torus localization computes each compact factor Euler characteristic. For a divisor with multiplicity profile, χ multiplies these counts. Smooth ordered distinct-root locus is (P1)^k; local nilpotent charts a²+bc=0 for ordinary doubled roots, uv=0 for exceptional roots give non-smooth components. Reduced discriminant degree 2k-2+s. Ordered root covering yields cohomology permutation modules on j-subsets, transposition -eigenrank binom(k-2,j-1), full S_k on H², trivial winding around fixed exceptional root. Independently checked J/C cutoff numbers m<=10, k<=8 transposition eigencounts and k=2 Euler profiles.
